entities.summary: Bolvadin is a city of Afyonkarahisar Province in Turkey. It is the seat of Bolvadin District. Bolvadin district has a total population of 45,468 according to the 2024 census. It has an altitude of 1,016 m. The mayor is Derviş Aynaci (MHP). Bolvadin district is a town in West Asia. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
